acceptedRisks.title: Cloud Armor and global rate limiting require an external HTTPS load balancer
acceptedRisks.reason: No load balancer, serverless NEG, stable public domain, or approved ChirpStack source IP is currently provisioned. Direct function ingress must remain available until that migration is tested.
acceptedRisks.compensatingControl: The webhook requires a rotatable Secret Manager credential, rejects oversized and invalid requests, applies instance-local throttling, records replay receipts transactionally, and emits rejection metrics.

acceptedRisks.title: Organization policies and organization-level SCC are unavailable
acceptedRisks.reason: The GCP project currently has no organization parent. Project-level IAM and CI controls are used until CWB establishes an organization resource.
acceptedRisks.compensatingControl: Project-level least-privilege IAM, dedicated runtime identities, Data Access logs, control-change alerts, and the cloud posture check detect or limit project-level drift.

acceptedRisks.title: Backup destination and restore project await governance approval
acceptedRisks.reason: A bucket retention period, backup data scope, notification channel, and isolated restore project must be approved before provisioning to avoid creating an unmanaged copy of sensitive data.
acceptedRisks.compensatingControl: Source and deployment configuration remain recoverable from protected Git history, while short-lived GPS trails are excluded from recovery by design; application data recovery remains unproven.

acceptedRisks.title: Security alerts do not yet have a tested notification channel
acceptedRisks.reason: Alert conditions can be provisioned without exposing contact data, but CWB must select an operational email, SMS, PagerDuty, or Pub/Sub destination and test delivery.
acceptedRisks.compensatingControl: Enabled log metrics and alert conditions plus a 365-day audit sink preserve detection evidence for manual investigation, but they do not provide paging until a channel is tested.

acceptedRisks.title: Webhook uses a rotatable bearer secret rather than timestamped HMAC or mTLS
acceptedRisks.reason: The current ChirpStack HTTP integration supports a static custom header but no per-request signature. Replay receipts and short retention reduce impact; a signing proxy or mTLS-capable integration is required for stronger sender proof.
acceptedRisks.compensatingControl: Constant-time credential comparison, Secret Manager rotation, transactional replay receipts, request limits, throttling, and rejection alerts limit credential and replay abuse.

acceptedRisks.title: Budget threshold and billing notification recipients await owner approval
acceptedRisks.reason: Creating an arbitrary budget without an approved monthly amount and recipient would produce misleading assurance. Approve a threshold and monitored channel before provisioning.
acceptedRisks.compensatingControl: Function payload and instance limits constrain application-layer consumption, while security metrics expose abnormal request volume; billing-cost detection remains manual until a budget channel is approved.
